'''''Ars Mathematica Contemporanea''''' is a quarterly [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] covering [[discrete mathematics]] in connection with other branches of [[mathematics]]. It is published by the [[University of Primorska]] together with the [[Society of Mathematicians, Physicists and Astronomers of Slovenia]], the [[Institute of Mathematics, Physics, and Mechanics]], and the [[Slovenian Discrete and Applied Mathematics Society]]. It is a [[open access#Diamond|platinum open access]] journal,<ref name=SDAMS>{{cite web |url=http://sdams.si/en/amc |title=Ars Mathematica Contemporanea |website=Slovenian Discrete and Applied Mathematics Society |access-date=October 5, 2019}}</ref> with articles published under the [[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0]] license.<ref name=AMCcopyright>{{cite web |url=https://amc-journal.eu/index.php/amc/about/submissions#copyrightNotice |title=Copyright Notice |website=Ars Mathematica Contemporanea |access-date=October 5, 2019}}</ref>

==Abstracting and indexing==
The journal is indexed by:
*[[Current Contents]]/Physical, Chemical & Earth Sciences
*[[Mathematical Reviews]]
*[[Science Citation Index Expanded]]
*[[Scopus]]
*[[zbMATH]]
According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2018 [[impact factor]] of 0.910.<ref name=WoS>{{cite book |year=2019 |chapter=Ars Mathematica Contemporanea |title=2018 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Clarivate Analytics]] |edition=Science |series=[[Web of Science]] |title-link=Journal Citation Reports}}</ref>
